result.markdown: --- title: >- [embedding.EmbeddingSentenceTransformers]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-class} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Creates an embedding function provider backed by sentence-transformers models. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_embedding_sentence_transformers.py#L12-L139){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python embedding.EmbeddingSentenceTransformers( model="all-MiniLM-L6-v2", device=None, batch_size=64, prompts=None ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Implements the [EmbeddingProvider](`raghilda.EmbeddingProvider`) interface. This provider runs models locally using the `sentence-transformers` library, enabling offline/private embedding without external API calls. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [model]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["all-MiniLM-L6-v2"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The sentence-transformers model to use. Default is "all-MiniLM-L6-v2". Any model from the Hugging Face Hub that is compatible with sentence-transformers can be used. [device]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The device to run the model on (e.g., "cpu", "cuda", "mps"). If None, sentence-transformers will auto-detect the best available device. [batch_size]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[64]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The number of texts to process in each batch. [prompts]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict[EmbedInputType, str] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional mapping from `EmbedInputType` to a prefix string to prepend to each text before encoding. This is useful for models that require task-specific prefixes (e.g., nomic-embed-text uses "search_query: " and "search_document: "). ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Install raghilda with sentence-transformers support: ```bash pip install raghilda[sentence-transformers] ``` ::: {#4e40b8f1 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from raghilda.embedding import EmbeddingSentenceTransformers provider = EmbeddingSentenceTransformers(model="all-MiniLM-L6-v2") embeddings = provider.embed(["hello world", "testing embeddings"]) print(len(embeddings)) print(len(embeddings[0])) # Dimension of the embedding ``` ::: For models that use task-specific prefixes: ::: {#4e8f717d .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} from raghilda.embedding import EmbeddingSentenceTransformers, EmbedInputType provider = EmbeddingSentenceTransformers( model="nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5", prompts={ EmbedInputType.QUERY: "search_query: ", EmbedInputType.DOCUMENT: "search_document: ", }, ) # Queries get "search_query: " prepended automatically query_emb = provider.embed(["Who is Laurens van Der Maaten?"], EmbedInputType.QUERY) # Documents get "search_document: " prepended automatically doc_emb = provider.embed(["TSNE is a dimensionality reduction algorithm"]) ``` :::
